mechanics.official_name: A fused split spell has the combined characteristics of its two halves. (See rule 709.4.)
Attacking doesn’t cause creatures with vigilance to tap. (See rule 508, “Declare Attackers Step.”)
Cleave’s second ability is a text-changing effect. See rule 612, “Text-Changing Effects.”
For more information about Auras, see rule 303, “Enchantments.”
For more information about Equipment, see rule 301, “Artifacts.”
For more information about Fortifications, see rule 301, “Artifacts.”
“Gift a card” means the effect is “The chosen player draws a card.”
“Gift a Food” means the effect is “The chosen player creates a Food token.”
“Gift a Treasure” means the effect is “The chosen player creates a Treasure token.”
“Gift an extra turn” means the effect is “The chosen player takes an extra turn after this one.”
If a bestowed Aura phases in unattached, it ceases to be bestowed. See rule 702.26, “Phasing.”
Overload’s second ability creates a text-changing effect. See rule 612, “Text-Changing Effects.”
The two abilities represented by champion are linked. See rule 607, “Linked Abilities.”
A regeneration effect replaces a destruction event. See rule 701.19, “Regenerate.”
“Adapt N” means “If this permanent has no +1/+1 counters on it, put N +1/+1 counters on it.”
“Clash with an opponent” means “Choose an opponent. You and that opponent each clash.”
“Harness [this permanent]” means “If this permanent isn’t harnessed, it becomes harnessed.”
To exile an object, move it to the exile zone from wherever it is. See rule 406, “Exile.”
To forage means “Exile three cards from your graveyard or sacrifice a Food.”
